name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this award. Example: https://openalex.org/G1234567890

name: display_name
description: The name or title of the award, if available.

name: description
description: A description of the award, if available.

name: funder_award_id
description: The award identifier as assigned by the funder (e.g., the grant number). Example: R01GM123456

name: funder
description: The funder that issued this award.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The OpenAlex ID for the funder Example: https://openalex.org/F4320306076

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: The name of the funder Example: National Science Foundation

fields.name: ror
fields.description: The ROR ID for the funder Example: https://ror.org/021nxhr62

fields.name: doi
fields.description: The DOI for the funder Example: https://doi.org/10.13039/100000001

name: funded_outputs
description: A list of OpenAlex Work IDs that were funded by this award. Example: ["https://openalex.org/W2741809807"]

name: funded_outputs_count
description: The number of works funded by this award. Example: 12

name: amount
description: The monetary amount of the award, if available. Example: 450000.0

name: currency
description: ISO 4217 currency code of the award amount; null when no amount is known. Most frequent: USD | EUR | JPY | CAD | GBP | CNY | TWD | BRL | CHF

name: funding_type
description: The type of funding provided; null for about 45% of awards. Observed values include: research | grant | fellowship | training | program | cooperative_agreement | career_development | intramural | contract | studentship | conference | award | infrastructure | collaborative_r&d

name: funder_scheme
description: The specific funding scheme or program under which the award was made, if available. Example: Horizon 2020, ERC Starting Grant

name: start_date
description: The start date of the award, formatted as an ISO 8601 date string, if available. Example: 2020-01-01

name: end_date
description: The end date of the award, formatted as an ISO 8601 date string, if available. Example: 2024-12-31

name: start_year
description: The year when the award started, if available. Example: 2020

name: end_year
description: The year when the award ends or ended, if available. Example: 2024

name: landing_page_url
description: A URL for the award's landing page, if available. Example: https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101000001

name: doi
description: The DOI for this award, if available. Example: https://doi.org/10.3030/101000001

name: provenance
description: The source this award record was harvested from. Observed values include: crossref_work_funders | nih_exporter | europepmc_work_funders | kaken | nsf_award_search | erasmus_plus | crossref_work.grants | nsfc_kd | usaspending | foerderkatalog | nserc_open_data | gateway_to_research | gepris | crossref_work | grb_most_projects

description: Information about the lead investigator (principal investigator) for this award, if available.
